Name: The Stardrop Menu
Author: AYODAISY
Description:
[heading][b]? Core Power Modules[/b][/heading]
[b]1. The "Ultimate Cheat" Suite[/b] Toggle the most essential powers with instant visual feedback.
[list]
[*][b]Noclip:[/b] Walk through buildings, trees, and water like a ghost.[/*]
[*][b]Time Freeze:[/b] Stop the clock entirely to get your chores done without the pressure of 2:00 AM.[/*]
[*][b]Fishing Mastery:[/b] Includes [b]Insta-Catch[/b] (instant bite the second your hook hits water) and a [b]Release Legendaries[/b] button to reset rare fish data so you can catch them again.[/*]
[/list][b]2. The Multi-Player Lobby[/b] Whether you are playing solo or with friends, the Lobby tab gives you full control over every farmer on the server.
[list]
[*][b]Gold Injection:[/b] Add or remove [b]10,000G[/b] with a single click.[/*]
[*][b]Survival:[/b] Trigger a [b]Full Heal[/b] (Health and Stamina) instantly.[/*]
[*][b]Teleport:[/b] Warp directly to any player’s location on the map.[/*]
[/list][b]3. Dynamic Item Spawner[/b] Access the entire 1.6 item registry with a professional-grade spawner.
[list]
[*][b]Live Search:[/b] Find any item instantly with the built-in search bar.[/*]
[*][b]Precision Slider:[/b] Choose your quantity from [b]1 to 999[/b] before spawning.[/*]
[*][b]Full Library:[/b] Includes every new item introduced in the 1.6 update.[/*]
[/list][b]4. World & Weather Manipulation[/b] Don't let the forecast ruin your plans.
[list]
[*][b]Weather Control:[/b] Force tomorrow's weather to be [b]Sunny, Rainy, Stormy,[/b] or [b]Snowy[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Time Warping:[/b] Jump straight to 6:00 AM or 12:00 PM to skip the wait.[/*]
[/list][b]5. Farm & Social Management[/b] Automate the tedious tasks so you can get back to the fun.
[list]
[*][b]Mass Watering:[/b] Instantly water every crop on your current map.[/*]
[*][b]Animal Care:[/b] Pet every animal on your farm with one button.[/*]
[*][b]God-Tier Social:[/b] Max out friendship hearts with every villager in town instantly.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]?️ Professional UI & Performance[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Wide-Format Layout:[/b] A massive 1250px interface ensures buttons are large and text never clips or squishes.[/*]
[*][b]Visual Confirmation:[/b] Buttons flash [b]Lime Green[/b] for successful toggles and [b]Red[/b] for removals, so you always know the mod heard you.[/*]
[*][b]Optimized Engine:[/b] Built to run [i]before[/i] the game calculates physics, ensuring Noclip and Time features are 100% stable.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]⌨️ Controls & Installation[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]To Open:[/b] Press [b]F1[/b] (Default).[/*]
[*][b]Navigation:[/b] Use the tabs at the top to switch between modules.[/*]
[*][b]Requirements:[/b] Requires [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] and [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/*]
[/list][b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]StardropMenu[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: An interactive mod menu for Stardew Valley.
